functions.purpose: TDR text-format deserializer for the cat-cuisine state record. Reads [catCuisineID] into *param_1 and [state] into param_1[1] via TdrText_FieldScalar. Sets up SEH frame and optional cleanup (FUN_10c3da30). Returns -0x13 (-19) if the source buffer (param_2) is null.
functions.serverRelevance: serialization plumbing (TDR text codec); struct is server-owned cat-cuisine state (see TlvCatCuisineState)
formulas: struct: +0x0 catCuisineID (int32, fmt DAT_11d9e0b4="%d"-style), +0x4 state (uint32, fmt DAT_11d9f574)
functions.notes: Text (debug/log) variant of the TDR codec, distinct from the binary TLV reader at 0x10171710 (TlvCatCuisineState). Matches TlvCatCuisineState fields field_1/field_2.

functions.purpose: TDR text-format serializer (writer) for the cat-cuisine state record: writes [catCuisineID]=*param_1 then [state]=param_1[1].
functions.notes: Pack counterpart of 0x101717d0.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a pet gathering/farm record. Emits curExp, level, gatherCount, lastRefreshTime, petID, gatherLevel in order (short-circuits on first non-zero return).
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server owns gather EXP/level and refresh timing); this is the client-side text codec mirror
formulas: struct layout: +0x0 curExp (int32), +0x4 level (int16), +0x6 gatherCount (int16), +0x8 lastRefreshTime (uint32), +0xc petID (int32), +0x10 gatherLevel (int16)
field width note: level/gatherCount/gatherLevel are 16-bit; curExp/lastRefreshTime/petID are 32-bit
functions.notes: Reveals per-pet gathering progression fields (gather EXP, gather level, gather count, last-refresh timestamp) that the server must track.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a pet avatar record: petID, skinID, a fixed 6-element avatarInfo array (byte-encoded via FUN_1010c010 with fmt 0x%02x-style), then sex (int8, fmt "0x%02x") and slot.
formulas: struct layout: +0x0 petID (int32), +0x4 skinID (int32), +0x8 avatarInfo[6] (each element 4 bytes, iterated 6x), +0x20 sex (int8, fmt "0x%02x"), +0x21 slot (uint32 read unaligned)
avatarInfo array header written via TdrText_ArrayHeader(...,6,0) then 6 elements
functions.notes: avatarInfo is a 6-entry array of appearance sub-values (customization). Uses TdrBuf_PutU8Z after array.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for the persistent Soul Beast state record. Emits soulBeastGID (int64), oCharLevel, oCharExp, oCharGlut (glutton/hunger), oEvloveStage, oImage, oFollow, oFeedTime.
formulas: struct layout: +0x0 soulBeastGID (int64, fmt "%I64u", uses *param_1 + param_1[1]), +0x8 oCharLevel (int32), +0xc oCharExp (int32), +0x10 oCharGlut/hunger (int32), +0x14 oEvloveStage (int32), +0x18 oImage/faceID (int32), +0x1c oFollow (int32), +0x20 oFeedTime (int32)
functions.notes: Core soul-beast growth/state fields: level, exp, glut (satiety/hunger), evolve stage, image (face), follow flag, feed timestamp. 'Evlove' is the game's spelling. Maps to TlvSoulBeastSystemData.

functions.purpose: TDR text reader for a cat-cuisine request: iCatCuisineID into *param_1, dwState into param_1[1]. Returns -0x13 if source null.
functions.notes: Same field pair as 0x101717d0 but different message (iCatCuisineID/dwState naming).

functions.purpose: TDR text writer for iCatCuisineID/dwState pair.
functions.notes: Pack counterpart of 0x102c00d0.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a variable-length pet blob: dwEntityId, iSize (bounds-checked), then szPet1[iSize] as a byte array. Validates size range before emitting.
functions.serverRelevance: validation (server enforces size bounds on the pet payload)
formulas: bounds check: if iSize<0 return -6; if iSize>0x400 (1024) return -7
functions.notes: szPet1 is a raw byte buffer capped at 1024. Server-side must clamp identically.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a pet farm/facility work request: iFacilityType, iFacilityIndex, iPlowLandIndex, a 4-element pet array, a 4-element tools array, and bSkipCutScene flag.
formulas: struct: +0x0 iFacilityType (int32), +0x4 iFacilityIndex (int32), +0x8 iPlowLandIndex (int32), +0xc pet[4] (4x int32), +0x1c tools[4] (4x int32), +0x2c bSkipCutScene (int8, fmt "0x%02x")
pet and tools arrays are fixed length 4 each (TdrText_ArrayHeader(...,4,0))
costs: up to 4 pets and 4 tools per facility work order
functions.notes: Farm system: assign up to 4 pets + 4 tools to a facility/plow-land slot.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for {iPetID, iFacilityType, iFacilityIndex}.
functions.notes: Identical layout to 0x103c1ab0 (two distinct messages share the struct).

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for {iPetID, iFacilityType, iFacilityIndex}; byte-identical to 0x103c1430.
functions.notes: Duplicate of 0x103c1430 for a sibling message type.

functions.purpose: TDR text reader for {iPetID, iErrCode}. Returns -0x13 if source null.
functions.notes: Generic pet-operation error response.

functions.purpose: TDR text writer for {iPetID, iErrCode}.
functions.notes: Pack counterpart of 0x103c1d80.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for {iPetID, iFacilityType, iFacilityIndex, nFacilitySlot}.
functions.notes: nFacilitySlot is 16-bit.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a facility-use response: iPetID, iErrCode, iFacilityType, iFacilityIndex, nFacilitySlot, nIsFirstUse, dwLeftTime.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server computes remaining time, first-use flag, error code)
formulas: struct: +0x0 iPetID (int32), +0x4 iErrCode (int32), +0x8 iFacilityType (int32), +0xc iFacilityIndex (int32), +0x10 nFacilitySlot (int16), +0x12 nIsFirstUse (int16), +0x14 dwLeftTime (uint32)
functions.notes: dwLeftTime = server-computed remaining cooldown/work time; nIsFirstUse gates first-use bonus/cutscene.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a pet TRAINING result: iErrCode, iPetID, iTrainID, then the resulting pet stats iMelee, iDefence, iMaxHP, iLoyalPoint, iSpirit, iPotential.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server computes post-training stat block; client only displays)
formulas: struct: +0x0 iErrCode (int32), +0x4 iPetID (int32), +0x8 iTrainID (int32), +0xc iMelee (int32), +0x10 iDefence (int32), +0x14 iMaxHP (int32), +0x18 iLoyalPoint (int32), +0x1c iSpirit (int32), +0x20 iPotential (int32)
functions.notes: Reveals the full pet stat vector affected by training: Melee (attack), Defence, MaxHP, LoyalPoint (loyalty), Spirit, Potential. iTrainID selects which training program was applied.

functions.purpose: TDR text reader for a single [szSoulBeastType] formatted value field; returns -0x13 (0xffffffed) if source null, else the TdrText_FieldValueFmt result.
formulas: single field [szSoulBeastType] via TdrText_FieldValueFmt; null guard -> 0xffffffed (-19)
functions.notes: One of a family of string-field codecs (0x104123c0/0x10412430/0x10412450/0x104124d0) for szSoulBeastType.

functions.purpose: Minimal TDR text writer for [szSoulBeastType] field.
functions.notes: Pack counterpart.

functions.purpose: TDR text reader for [szSoulBeastType] into a caller buffer with NUL termination; returns &DAT_11d9d32b (empty string) if buffer/len null.
formulas: NUL-terminates output buffer at index 0 (or -1 if len==0)
functions.notes: Buffer-writing variant.

functions.purpose: TDR text reader for [szSoulBeastType] into a bounded buffer; clamps NUL position to cap-1 via TdrBuf_PutNulAt.
formulas: clamp: if cap<=len then nulPos = cap-1; TdrBuf_PutNulAt(cap,nulPos)
functions.notes: Bounded string variant.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for {iPetIdx, iDateDay, iCurHigher} - a per-pet daily record tracking a date-day and a current-highest value.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server tracks daily counter/highest with date-day reset)
functions.notes: iCurHigher likely a daily best-value (e.g. gather/training peak) with iDateDay used for daily reset.

functions.purpose: Config-manager accessor: obtains the CCatCuisineInfo singleton (falling back to CInfoManager::FindByName), then returns the record pointer at linear index param_1 from array [mgr+0x14 .. mgr+0x18].
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (static config table lookup; server would have its own copy)
formulas: return *(mgr[5] + param_1*4)  where mgr[5]=array begin, mgr[6]=array end
functions.notes: Standard CInfoManager singleton pattern (lazy-init guard DAT_123be344 bit0). Array of record pointers, 4-byte elements.

functions.purpose: Resolves the CCatCuisineInfo singleton and calls its vtable+0x28 method (release/cleanup).
functions.notes: Cleanup helper for the config singleton.

functions.purpose: Scaleform UI: rebuilds the _petList VO array (PetPropertyALLVO_CLASS_NAME) by iterating the panel's pet list (records stride 0x30 between +0x134 and +0x138), calling CPetInfoPanel::BuildPetDetailVO_ByLookup per pet, then invokes Flash ResetPos / RefreshPetInfoByPos.
formulas: pet record iteration: from *(this+0x134) to *(this+0x138), stride 0x30
functions.notes: Flash/Scaleform plumbing. Pet list node is 0x30 bytes.

functions.purpose: Scaleform UI dispatcher: depending on a mode check (FUN_1050a550), rebuilds the pet property view via CPetPanelUI::BuildSubSkillListVO + BuildEquippedSkillLists, sets _PetPos, fires RefreshPetPropertyUI and _root.Global_PetAvatarRefresh; sets dirty flags at +0x18c/+0x18d.
functions.notes: Builds sub-skill (support-cat skills) and equipped-skill lists in the UI. Actual skill data comes from server; this only renders.

functions.purpose: Scaleform UI: mode-gated refresh that sets _PetPos, calls RefreshPetInfoByPos and ShowAsEnviroment(*(this+0x180)); otherwise delegates to RefreshPetList (0x10510ff0).
functions.notes: ShowAsEnviroment toggle uses field +0x180.

functions.purpose: Handles the 'fire/dismiss pet' (FirePet) confirm flow: sets a flag at +0x1a0, resolves CMessageParmDescInfo config, and pops a MsgBox with OK/Cancel (MsgBoxFirePetOk / MsgBoxFirePetCancel), message id 0x1fb5.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (confirmation dialog; the actual fire request goes elsewhere)
formulas: message-param 2D lookup index: iVar5 = 0x2f - mgr[0xc]; valid if 0<=iVar5<mgr[9]; row=mgr[8][iVar5/mgr[10]], col index iVar5%mgr[10]
functions.notes: 0x2f is a fixed message-descriptor id offset; 0x70 error path calls FUN_10c3d580(0x70).

functions.purpose: Scaleform: fetches the FlashUI render target and blits the pet avatar into the 'petavatarimg' element, scaling by a DPI factor from the render device.
functions.notes: Pure rendering; refcount management on the Flash object.

functions.purpose: Scaleform: builds _PetsList VO array with per-pet strName, level, petindex, petid, status; iterates pet nodes (stride 0x30) and calls BuildPetDetailVO_ByLookup + BuildPetInfoVO for the selected pet.
formulas: per-node fields: +0x04 level, +0x1c (icon/asset key), +0x20 status, +0x28 petid, +0x2c petindex; stride 0x30
functions.notes: Confirms pet-list node layout (level@+4, status@+0x20, petid@+0x28, petindex@+0x2c).

functions.purpose: Scaleform: variant of BuildPetsListVO that also drives default-selection and calls BuildPetInfoVO under several fallback conditions (empty list, param_3 flag).
formulas: on first node when !param_3: set selection *(this+0x34)=node+0x2c, *(this+0x38)=node+0x28
functions.notes: Selection/default-pet logic for the pet panel.

functions.purpose: Scaleform: builds the _PetEquips VO array (PETEQUIPITEMVO_CLASS_NAME) from the pet's equipment list (nodes stride 0x40 between +0x158 and +0x15c), emitting asset, name, collumn, m_bUseItem, isBind, m_nBindType; then fires RefreshPetEquipsUI.
formulas: equip node stride 0x40 (0x10 int words); fields: +0x0 itemId, +0x4 (id2), +0x8 collumn, +0x2c asset, +0x34 m_bUseItem(=0<node[0xd]), +0x38 isBind(node[0xe]), +0x3c m_nBindType(node[0xf])
functions.notes: Pet equipment slot record is 0x40 bytes; m_bUseItem = (durability/use count node[0xd] > 0).

functions.purpose: Scaleform: positions/scales the 3D pet avatar render (color-transform + translate) reading 4 double values from the incoming VO (offsets +0x8, +0x20, +0x38, +0x50) and blits into petavatarimg when dirty.
formulas: reads doubles at VO+0x8, +0x20, +0x38, +0x50 (guarded by type-tag byte &0x8f==5 meaning double)
final translate/scale multiplied by device scale factor and _DAT_11de99c8/_DAT_11de99d8
functions.notes: Rendering-only; VO type tag 5 = double in the Scaleform value union.

functions.purpose: Scaleform: writes the pet's display name into the _PetName field (name fetched via FUN_112f64e0 from pet id at +0x34/+0x38).
functions.notes: Pet name resolved from selected pet id (this+0x34 petindex, this+0x38 petid).

functions.purpose: Loads the persisted 'PetShowChxTime' timestamp, converts both it and now via _localtime64_s, and sets an output flag when the stored year/month/day differ from today (daily-reset detection for a pet UI 'show' hint).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (local persisted preference / daily flag, not server state)
formulas: reset trigger if (storedYear != todayYear) || (storedMon != todayMon) || (storedDay != todayMday); day compared via tm_isdst field reuse (decompiler artifact)
functions.notes: Uses local config store (FUN_1126e800 key 'PetShowChxTime'). Client daily-hint bookkeeping only.

functions.purpose: Writes/clears the persisted 'PetShowChxTime' value (stores current time via FUN_111f8d20 when flag set, else clears) in the local config store.
functions.notes: Setter counterpart to 0x105193a0.

functions.purpose: Scaleform: when the panel's tracked item id (+0x48) matches the local player's current item context (entity +0xf8), sets _PetPos and fires SetRequireItemId / RefreshPetPropertyUI.
functions.notes: Refreshes required-item display for pet actions.

functions.purpose: CSoulBeastInfo config accessor with base-offset + 2D (row/col) indexing: resolves singleton, adjusts id by base offset mgr[0xc], then indexes the row/col table (cols = mgr[10]).
formulas: row = mgr[8][idx / mgr[10]]; return row[idx % mgr[10]]
functions.notes: Sparse 2D bucket table (mgr[8]=row-ptr array, mgr[9]=capacity, mgr[10]=bucket width, mgr[0xc]=min id). Lazy-init guard DAT_123c7298.

functions.purpose: CSoulBeastInfo linear-index accessor: returns record ptr at index param_1 from [mgr+0x14..mgr+0x18].
functions.notes: Linear counterpart of the 2D accessor at 0x10520400.

functions.purpose: Resolves CSoulBeastInfo singleton and calls its vtable+0x28 cleanup method.
functions.notes: Cleanup helper.

functions.purpose: Initializes the Soul Beast panel's Flash<->native callback registry, binding external interface names to handlers: InitModel, GetSoulStoneData, GetAttrUpData, Reset, StageUp, UnlockStage, LearnAttr, GetItemName, CloseUI, SetAvatarFrameData, SendSoulBeastSocialAction, GetSoulBeastSocialActionData, UnLockBeast, GetSoulBeastConditionArr, GetSoulBeastData, GetSoulBeastDetailData, GetSoulBeastFace, GetSoulBeastFood, OnlyOneFeedTips, FeedSoulBeast, IsAchieveMaxLevel, etc. Also caches gfx_draw/gfx_draw_only material handles.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI dispatch table; the named actions map to server requests handled elsewhere)
functions.notes: Enumerates the full soul-beast client action surface: StageUp/UnlockStage (evolution), LearnAttr (attribute/skill learning), FeedSoulBeast (feeding), UnLockBeast. Handler bodies (FUN_10525xxx/FUN_10526xxx) are outside this chunk. gfx_draw material handles stored at this+0x2c/+0x30.

functions.purpose: Registers avatar-refresh callbacks (event ids 0x1121/0x1122) and fires _root.Global_SoulBeastAvatarRefresh; stores the avatar object at this+0x44.
functions.notes: Avatar preview wiring.

functions.purpose: Builds the soul-beast stage/unlock condition VO array (lockConditionArr): for each condition evaluates an unlock checker and emits iUnlockType, bIsUnlock, iUnlockParam, and (for level-type conditions) a param label; sets aggregate bIsUnlock/lockType and lockConditionTips.
functions.serverRelevance: validation (mirrors server-side unlock rules for display; server is authoritative on whether a stage is unlocked)
formulas: aggregate bIsUnlock stays true only while every condition returns true

switch(unlockType): case 1/2/4/5/6 -> iUnlockParam = *(cond+4); case 3 (level/quest) -> iUnlockParam = *(cond+8), and label lookup key = *(cond+4)*100 + *(cond+8) via FUN_10520b90, label from result+0x14
non-checker branch (FUN_11412fc0 true): reads current level (FUN_11439380 -> iLevel) and a second value (FUN_11439200), lockType=2
functions.notes: Unlock condition types: type 3 uses composite key type*100+param (e.g. chapter/quest gating). Reveals unlock-condition struct: +0x4 and +0x8 are the two params. Server must enforce these before allowing StageUp/UnlockStage.

functions.purpose: KEY FORMULA FUNCTION. Builds the soul-beast feed/evolve detail VO: current level/growth/hunger and their caps, max-level/evolve state, evolution gold+silver+item costs and affordability flags, and food-box capacity. Reads evolve-info and level-up-info config records.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server owns level/growth/hunger and computes evolution eligibility & cost consumption; this is the client mirror for the confirm UI, so exact numbers match server rules)
formulas: iMaxLevel selection: if curLevel >= CSoulBeastLevelUpInfo::GetMaxLevel(type) -> 0xffffffff(-1); else if evolveStage < CSoulBeastEvolveInfo::GetMaxEvolveStage(type) -> nextEvolve.reqLevel(evolveInfo+0x1c); else -> 0xfffffffe(-2)
iNeedGold = evolveInfo(+0x24); bEnoughGold = iNeedGold <= FUN_11396e10(iNeedGold, 0)  [currency-0 balance check]
iNeedSilver = evolveInfo(+0x20); bEnoughSilver = (gold+silver) <= FUN_11396e10(gold+silver, 1)  [currency-1 balance check]

arrNeedItems: iterate evolve item-req list from *(evolveInfo+0x30) down to (evolveInfo+0x28), stride 0x10; per item iItemId(+0x10), iItemCount(+0x14), bEnough = required(+0x14) <= inventoryCount(FUN_113fa380(itemId))
costs: evolution silver cost = evolveInfo+0x20 (checked as gold+silver combined)
evolution material items = list at evolveInfo+0x28..+0x30 (stride 0x10: itemId@+0x10, count@+0x14)
level cap sentinels: -1 = at max level, -2 = at max evolve stage
functions.notes: evolveInfo struct offsets: +0x1c reqLevel for next stage, +0x20 silver cost, +0x24 gold cost, +0x28/+0x30 item-requirement vector (begin/end). CSoulBeastEvolveInfo (config) confirmed in schema (soulBeastId@0x14, evolveStage@0x18). Currency checker FUN_11396e10(amount, currencyType) returns available balance; type 0=gold, 1=silver.

functions.purpose: Builds the beastFaceArray VO and CurrentFaceID: iterates all face/appearance config entries emitting iItemId, strIcon, iLevel(req level), isLock (locked if current level below req), bIsUse (equipped == current face id).
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server owns current face id and unlock-by-level); client mirror for UI
formulas: per-face fields: +0x4 iItemId, +0x1c strIcon, +0x50 iLevel (required level)
functions.notes: Face unlock gate is purely by soul-beast level (face.reqLevel at +0x50).

functions.purpose: Builds the beastFoodArray VO: iterates the soul-beast's valid food item list emitting iItemId, iItemCount (player inventory count), and iItemLevel.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server validates feed-item eligibility & consumes items); client mirror
formulas: per-food fields: +0x4 iItemId; iItemCount = FUN_113fa380(itemId) (owned count); iItemLevel = foodItem.vtbl+0x18()
functions.notes: Food list sourced from soul-beast config record (FUN_115aad30 -> list at +0x1c..+0x20). Feeding item level affects growth gain (growth/hunger applied server-side).

functions.purpose: Scaleform: color-transforms and positions the soul-beast 3D avatar into avatarSoulBeastShow, reading 4 doubles from the VO and firing _root.Global_SoulBeastAvatarRefresh; near-identical to the pet variant at 0x10516d50.
formulas: reads doubles at VO +0x8/+0x20/+0x38/+0x50; scale by device factor * _DAT_11de99c0
functions.notes: Rendering only.

functions.purpose: Scaleform: blits the soul-beast avatar into the avatarSoulBeastShow element scaled by device DPI factor.
functions.notes: Rendering only; sibling of 0x10512a20.

functions.purpose: CPetInfo config accessor with base-offset + 2D (row/col) indexing (identical pattern to CSoulBeastInfo::GetRecordById), returning the pet config record for a pet id.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (static pet config table; server keeps its own)
formulas: row = mgr[0x20][idx / mgr[0x28]]; return row[idx % mgr[0x28]]
functions.notes: CPetInfo manager: +0x20 row-ptr array, +0x24 capacity, +0x28 bucket width, +0x30 min id. Lazy-init guard DAT_123be7b4.

functions.purpose: Loads Libs/WeaponUIConfig.xml (WeaponUICOnfigs): parses GlobalConfig (maxscale/minscale/scalespeed), per-weapon WeaponConfigs (indexed by weaponid-0x1f into a 12-slot table stride 0x48), EquipConfigs with PlayerConfig and PetConfig, and WeaponConfigOverride entries.
formulas: weapon slot index = weaponid - 0x1f, valid range [0,0xc); slot base = base + index*0x48
functions.notes: Only PetConfig block (this+0x40c) is pet-relevant here: display transform for the pet weapon/model in UI. Not gameplay data.

functions.purpose: CPetEquipInfo config accessor with base-offset + 2D indexing (same pattern as CPetInfo), returning the pet-equipment config record for an id.
formulas: idx = id - mgr[0x30]; valid if 0<=idx<mgr[0x24]; row=mgr[0x20][idx/mgr[0x28]]; return row[idx%mgr[0x28]]
functions.notes: Lazy-init guard DAT_123bea3c. Manager offsets 0x20/0x24/0x28/0x30 as in CPetInfo.

functions.purpose: Serializes a large block of client game-settings CVars (camera, input, display, gameplay toggles) via sprintf into a settings buffer. Stock settings-persistence code; among the many CVars are pet-related display toggles handled in the loader sibling.
functions.notes: Not pet gameplay logic - included in this chunk only because it neighbors pet CVars. CryEngine CVar plumbing.

functions.purpose: Loads/applies client game-settings CVars including the pet-name display toggles cl_ShowPlayerPetName and cl_ShowHeroPetName (plus refuse-request, name-pad, effect-hide toggles).
functions.notes: cl_ShowPlayerPetName / cl_ShowHeroPetName are the only pet-touching entries; purely local display preferences. CryEngine CVar plumbing.
